title: IRGC warns US: 'make a mistake, and you will face PAINFUL strikes'
text:
IRGC warns US: 'make a mistake, and you will face PAINFUL strikes'"

"Cites intel that 'US has decided to resume hostile actions against Iran… with green light of certain regional states'"

"'Should US commit any error against Iran, all its bases and interests in region will be targeted by continuous, effective, painful strikes'
